entry_point: HTTP storages:create / storages:update / storages:updateOrCreate / storages:firstOrCreate plus multipart attachments:create; the plugin manager enable/remove API and CLI; the plugin package detail request

verified.entry_point: Confirmed offline at the pinned commit: (a) an HTTP storage update/create/updateOrCreate/firstOrCreate with a root outside the managed area is accepted and the following multipart attachment upload writes the file there; (b) a cached local storage path that escapes makes multer create the directory and write the file outside; (c) PluginManager.enable / `pm enable` with an absolute marker-module path imports and executes it, and PluginManager.remove deletes an arbitrary directory; (d) the injected plugin-detail request returns a marked package.json from an arbitrary directory and the injected storage probe writes a file at a client-chosen root. All driven through a mock server and the project's own resourcer/vitest harness.

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the refusal contract accepts any error response and the observable requirement is the absence of the outside effect; a fix that crashes on legitimate uploads is caught by the functional suite, and no separate crash-only patch is built.
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: each route validates the exact location it is about to write, read or delete; there is no neighbouring or proxy object to authorise instead.
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: confinement has no role, peer or direction dimension; the read (plugin metadata) and write (probe/storage) paths are covered by separate tests, not by one toggle.
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the inputs are filesystem locations and package names; a non-string value is rejected by type checks and has no security-relevant alternative spelling here.
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: confinement is decided from local configuration and path arithmetic; no external authority lookup can fail open.
